changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgrouting;

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS streets AS SELECT l.osm_id, l.name, l.highway, ST_Length(ST_Transform(l.way, 4326)::geography) AS length_m, l.way AS geom, p.name AS region FROM planet_osm_line l LEFT JOIN planet_osm_polygon p ON p.admin_level = '6' AND p.boundary = 'administrative' AND ST_Intersects(l.way, p.way) WHERE l.highway IS NOT NULL AND l.name IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE streets ADD COLUMN id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY;

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_streets_geom ON streets USING GIST(geom);

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS road_network AS SELECT osm_id AS id, name, highway, ST_Transform(way, 4326) AS geom, ST_Length(ST_Transform(way, 4326)::geography) AS cost FROM planet_osm_line WHERE highway IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE road_network ADD COLUMN rid SERIAL PRIMARY KEY;

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE road_network ADD COLUMN source INTEGER; ALTER TABLE road_network ADD COLUMN target INTEGER;

rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_road_network_geom ON road_network USING GIST(geom);
